families.ground_truth_rule: the Code4rena verdict for the finding
a root cause stated by a source, or an invariant stated by a source; unscorable otherwise
an attacker model derived from the cited source or reported by the audit; unknown is a valid answer
a PoC body published in the report
an executed run recorded by the pipeline
an exploit executed at the audited revision, with the security property observed to be violated
an attempted exploit executed at the audited revision
the same exploit executed against the vulnerable AND the fixed revision

ground_truth_rules.A_vulnerability_detection: the Code4rena verdict for the finding
ground_truth_rules.B_root_cause_reasoning: a root cause stated by a source, or an invariant stated by a source; unscorable otherwise
ground_truth_rules.C_attacker_reasoning: an attacker model derived from the cited source or reported by the audit; unknown is a valid answer
ground_truth_rules.D_exploit_construction: a PoC body published in the report
ground_truth_rules.E_exploit_verification: an executed run recorded by the pipeline
ground_truth_rules.H_verified_exploit: an exploit executed at the audited revision, with the security property observed to be violated
ground_truth_rules.I_verified_non_exploit: an attempted exploit executed at the audited revision
ground_truth_rules.J_verified_patch: the same exploit executed against the vulnerable AND the fixed revision

policy: A task counts as scorable only when its answer key comes from an experiment or from a named public verdict. Report claims alone never produce a scorable task. Rows duplicated inside a split are collapsed, which is why the totals are lower than the v2 pipeline reported.
